blocks.title: Surface tension
blocks.text: Surface tension liquids ki woh khasoosiyat hai jo liquid ki satah ke saath kaam karne wali quwwat bayan karti hai, jis se woh lachakdar chadar ki tarah bartao karti hai. Yeh satah ke molecules ke darmiyan intermolecular forces se paida hoti hai.

Satah ke molecules intermolecular forces se kul andar ki taraf quwwat mehsoos karte hain, jo satah par ek jhilli (skin) banati hai. Surface tension ki wajah se liquids apna surface area kam se kam rakhne ka rujhan rakhte hain, isi liye qatre kurre bante hain; yeh capillary action, sathon ke geela hone aur qatron aur bulbulon ke banne par bhi asar karti hai. Machhar pani par us ki zyada surface tension ki wajah se tair sakte hain. Surface tension aam taur par darja hararat barhne se ghatti hai, aur mazboot intermolecular forces zyada surface tension deti hain. Alamat gamma hai; Table 5.3 ki qeematein 10^-3 N fi m ke zarb hain, to 20 degrees C par pani 72.75 x 10^-3 N fi m, ya 72.75 dynes fi cm hai.

blocks.caption: 20 degrees C par kuch liquids ki surface tension 10^-3 N fi m mein (Table 5.3)

blocks.prompt: Acetone, ethanol aur methoxymethane (dimethyl ether, CH3OCH3) ko wajuhat ke saath barhti surface tension ki tarteeb mein rakhein.
blocks.explanation: Surface tension intermolecular forces ki mazbooti ke saath barhti hai. Dimethyl ether chhota polar molecule hai jis mein sirf kamzor dipole-dipole forces hain aur koi O-H group nahi. Acetone zyada polar hai, mazboot C=O dipole ke saath. Ethanol mein O-H group hai aur woh hydrogen bonds banata hai. To tarteeb dimethyl ether < acetone < ethanol hai.

items: Surface tension (gamma, N fi m) satah ke molecules par andar ki taraf khinchao hai jo liquid ki satah ko jhilli ki tarah banata hai: kurrawi qatre, capillary action, geela hona, bulbule; darja hararat se ghatti aur mazboot forces se barhti hai (pani 72.75, ethanol 22.75 x 10^-3 N fi m).
